Do you know Bond, alteast the very early films were based on Ian Flemmings books whose inspiration was borrowed from real-life accounts of actual people?

McLean, Burgess, Philby, Blunt, Dusko Popov, James Charles Bond, etc. In Dr. No where Bond takes off his wetsuit to reveal a tuxedo, it was based on an actual mission by Dutch spy Peter Tazelaar, contact Holland who worked for British Intelligence. Of course, there is theatrical licence to make it entertaining, melding of characters and locations for continuity, but in whole, they are a great romp.

If you want a more realistic espionage film watch The Conversation, Munich, Ipcress File, Argo, Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy, Three Days Of The Condor.
